# `emptyCallbackToNever`

Suggests Effect.never instead of Effect.callback with an empty register

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377164` |
| Language Service name | `emptyCallbackToNever` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/empty-callback-to-never` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

export const daemon = Effect.log("worker started").pipe(
  Effect.andThen(Effect.callback<never>(() => {}))
/**
                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(empty-callback-to-never): This `Effect.callback` register is empty, so the effect never completes. Use `Effect.never` instead.
*/
)
```
